required_proof_if_yes: identify exact source path and executable call chain
prove envelope verification is mandatory before _validate_observation_receipt or compose it into the retained gate
bind producer_id or equivalent trusted producer identity
bind source payload digest or immutable subject digest
bind receipt subject digest and receipt replay identity
reject unknown producer and stale/replayed envelope
first_discriminator.required_action_if_no: Implement exactly one retained OBSERVED evidence producer authority plus instance-level admission envelope. Reuse the A02/generation-provenance authority pattern where structurally valid, but do not create a parallel semantic labeler or truth store.

trusted_producer_fields: repo_path or typed runtime producer identity
minimum_authority_schema.verification_rule: All authority-derived expected values must be independently recomputed or resolved from one trusted authority boundary. Caller strings are never sufficient merely because nonempty.

phase_p1_nonempty_history_authority.problem: Structural replay integrity is already confirmed, but genesis plus the complete ordered nonempty event history lacks a trusted producer/content-provenance root. A row can be structurally self-consistent yet originate from an unauthorized history construction.
phase_p1_nonempty_history_authority.design_rule: Extend the retained generation-provenance pattern across the whole ordered history without creating a second state semantics implementation. The existing deterministic U/D/f labelers remain transition/order semantics; producer authority only proves origin and exact ordered content.
minimum_bound_identity: ordered list of event semantic digests
history root digest over ordered sequence
acceptance: exact replay from authenticated genesis/history objects reproduces supplied state_before
every mutation fails before positive-row eligibility
history-root verification does not rely on a caller-supplied digest without independent recomputation
idempotent identical-event semantics receive one isolated test rather than being obscured by unrelated receipt-list duplication
empty/single-event retained cases remain backward-compatible only if their provenance contracts still pass
no positive training rows are emitted by the proof itself

phase_p2_full_matched_baseline.purpose: Select or reject a serious 0.8B starting checkpoint without giving the TARGET_MEASURED-only eight-case pilot winner credit.
preregistration_must_freeze: exact case IDs and split/family ancestry
same prompts and model-visible serialization across candidates except unavoidable tokenizer differences that are separately logged

minimum retention floors per required capability
failure rule when no candidate clears floors

coding/tool-use retention where measurable on the small model interface
phase_p2_full_matched_baseline.selection_rule: No checkpoint is selected unless it clears every preregistered required-retention floor and the low-refusal target; aggregate superiority cannot compensate for a failed mandatory cognitive channel. If none clears, status is NO_WINNER_INVESTIGATE rather than choosing the least-bad model.
required_outputs: immutable preregistration contract committed before full run
one receipt per candidate bound to exact revision/file manifest/runtime
explicit winner/null decision with no causal J-Space inference
selection credit only at the declared matched-baseline scope
